name: Enrich Contacts
runs_on: Table Companies (implied), a View by name on the launch row; the insert doors call it as a sub-workflow with View Not Sourced and Domains = what they landed
reads: Domain, Company, Employees on Companies; the held People at those domains (record id, Contact Key, LinkedIn URL, Email, Contact Source, Title, Phone, Seniority, Department, Source ID); the DNC table; the relevant People at those domains before the Supersoniq gate
creates: on People: Name, first_name, last_name, Title, Seniority, Department, Email, LinkedIn URL, Phone, Companies, Contact Key, Contact Source (multi-select), Source ID; on Companies: Contacts Pulled At
held_value: a held person (by Contact Key or LinkedIn slug) is updated: blanks filled, Email appended, Contact Source added; a filled Title, Seniority, Department, Phone or Source ID is never overwritten
providers: Blitz, GetLeads, QuickEnrich, Supersoniq, in that priority, every one asked for every company; no credential, out of credits or dead = logged skip. Cap and floor by the Employees value on our row (up to 50 or unknown: 20 wide; 51 to 500: 30 non-junior; 501 and up: 50 manager and up). Supersoniq: hard cap 10, Director and up, asked only for companies with fewer than 5 relevant people
logs: the launch row only, refreshed after each provider closes and finalized at the end: per provider chunks, called, returned, credits, new, held filled, written, errors; the merge; the Supersoniq gate; coverage; the email hand-off
handoff: Enrich Emails, once, on People view Not Waterfalled
